BiblicalUsage: Pirchach means a brood, young ones rising together. It stands once, in Job 30:12, where Job says the youth rise upon his right hand — the young brood pushing away his feet and raising the ways of their destruction against him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's complaint is honest: it hurts most when the young rise up against the old.
